description: This file defines the CustomPageExceptionHtmlSubscriber class, which handles custom HTML error pages (403 and 404) in Drupal by subscribing to exception events and making subrequests to custom error paths.

classes.name: CustomPageExceptionHtmlSubscriber
classes.description: A Drupal event subscriber class that handles custom error pages for 403 and 404 errors by intercepting exception events and making subrequests to custom error paths.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dependencies such as config factory, HTTP kernel, logger, redirect destination, router, and access manager.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the subscriber, set to -50.

methods.name: on403
methods.description: Handles 403 Forbidden errors by making a subrequest to a custom page if configured.

methods.name: on404
methods.description: Handles 404 Not Found errors by making a subrequest to a custom page if configured.

methods.name: makeSubrequestToCustomPath
methods.description: Creates and executes a subrequest to a custom error page path, checking access permissions before proceeding.
